reference.name: Meowdoku
reference.versionEvidence: Read installed official app wrapper Info.plist after this playtest
reference.surface: Installed iOS app on Mac, live CUA native screenshots and double-clicks

completed: Opened the app and selected its running wrapper window after duplicate app identifiers prevented initial binding
Observed restored level4:6x6 board,2found,576score,two available life fish and one wrong mark
Observed the completed happy board, an automatic daily-check-in page showing current/best2, then pressed Continue
Observed a horn-playing victory character and the level5 action; left at victory

observations.seen: Each sampled correct shows a happy expression and small heart at the accepted cell, with bright sparkles and region-colored fragments around it. Floating576/672/768/864 sits near the source rather than far across the board.
observations.decision: Keep the accepted character readable and its local acknowledgement associated with that cell. Inspect existing Capydoku reward travel before adding more effects.

observations.seen: The sequence showed Calm Paws!, Clever Streak!, Nice, then Great. A nearby thumb/clapping decoration appeared in some sampled frames.
observations.boundary: Observed text and increments do not define frozen scoring thresholds or authorize replacing the original configuration. No scoring values changed.

observations.seen: The final board shows smiling cats with hearts. After the check-in page, victory shows a large cat with a party horn, rays and confetti. Two later screenshots show different face/arm/body poses, followed by explanatory copy and the level5 action.
observations.boundary: Snapshots do not prove animation duration, interpolation technology, exact button availability timing or frame rate. Capydoku retains original art and immediately usable actions.
